name: Nortrup (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged below the centre with the municipal arms of Nortrup (a dragon and ears of wheat over a cogwheel on red and white).
history: The arms, designed by Ulf-Dietrich Korn, were granted by the Landkreis Osnabrück in 1983.

features.role: Nortrup arms — dragon, ears and cogwheel
